name: GPU Octree Voxelization via Triangle-AABB Intersection
definition: A GPU-accelerated voxelization technique that constructs an octree from triangle meshes. It uses CUDA kernels to compute bounding boxes, perform triangle intersection tests, and calculate signed distances to determine leaf node properties.
summary: GPU Octree Voxelization via Triangle-AABB Intersection builds octrees from triangle meshes by offloading expensive geometric queries to CUDA kernels while keeping recursive subdivision logic on the CPU.
